page.overview:
Who is Ansel Virro?

Graf Ansel Virro was a member of the Janusian Faithful.

Ansel Virro travelled to Arrakis alongside other nobles including Phaedra Vye, Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Agade Yimari, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Roella Ramsby, Oona Byrn, Venesir Ask, Bianca Bagetti, Eulalia Harthorn and Hesperia Farani. The group were very secretive, refusing to dine with House Atreides, attend the salons or allow anyone outside their group to dine with them.

Virro attended a banquet alongside Harthorn, Yimari, Ramsby, Bagetti and Byrn, during which he spilled a goblet of wine. They all drank poisoned wine and the masks were also poisoned and sealed to the wearers' faces, causing Virro to choke to death. The scene was later investigated by Dhood Shazz and the Prisoner.
